name: Docs (Context7)
summary: Look up current documentation for the libraries you code with.
description: Lets her look up current, version-specific documentation for the libraries you code with, so her code uses today's APIs. Read only.
about: Context7 serves up-to-date documentation and code examples for thousands of libraries. She asks it when she writes code with a library.
It works without a key; a free key from context7.com raises its limits. Its code comes from npm (@upstash/context7-mcp, version 4.4.4); we tested that version.

mcp.name: context7

secrets.label: Context7 key (optional)
secrets.tip: Optional. A free key from context7.com raises how many lookups you can do. Leave it empty to use it without one.

guide: Add this tool server, then press Test.

reviewNotes: Started on Windows 11 with Sara 2.57.0: initialize and tools/list answered with 2 tools.
